description: Lets Oblipali send your store's emails from a subdomain of your domain (for example mail.yourstore.com): DKIM signature and bounce handling (MX and SPF) in the sending group, and a DMARC record in the dmarc group, applied only when the domain has no DMARC policy yet. Your usual mailbox and website are not affected.
variableDescription: dkimkey: DKIM public key generated for this subdomain (without the p= prefix). region: sending region of the bounce server, for example eu-west-1.
